ideas.pitch: An interactive civic engagement tool for Mississauga residents to allocate the city budget and instantly simulate infrastructure impacts using local open data.
ideas.title: Mississauga Municipal Budget Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem local judges and organizers feel directly in their municipality, matching the pattern of solving localized community pain points.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and local drone imagery monitoring tool designed for industrial land use compliance in Peel Region, tracking environmental regulations.
ideas.title: Ontario Manufacturing Compliance Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the technical execution of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision to regional land compliance.

ideas.pitch: An automated logistics app coordinating volunteer drivers and community centres to group isolated seniors across the Greater Toronto Area into social outings.
ideas.title: GTA Senior Mobility Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of the Vanderbilt Global Good Hackathon by targeting clear social impact with measurable local volunteer metrics.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard that predicts provincial grant eligibility and tax compliance incidents for small businesses in Mississauga using Poisson regression models.
ideas.title: Peel Small Business AI Tax & Grant Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs rigorous statistical forecasting methods similar to the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon winner to provide concrete economic benefits.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust verification platform tailored for dental and health clinics across Mississauga to streamline intake and reviews.
ideas.title: Local Clinic Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the exact prize-winning mechanics of the Global-Smile prosthodontic platform by addressing a direct operational friction point for local practices.
